lines.en: The Sayunaari have received your message, Lord Jaromir. They have departed and are bound for home.
lines.zh: 萨育纳人收到了您的口信，贾洛米公爵。他们已经启程回乡了。

lines.en: Is there something more, my lord?

...  No.
One last thing...  Did their leader take kindly to our gifts?
Well, my lord, the female seemed somewhat crestfallen. Not about the gift, but something else. Perhaps they preferred to stay longer, my lord?
lines.zh: 唔，大人，那位女士似乎有些郁郁寡欢。与礼物无关，而是由于别的原因。也许他们本希望能多待上一些时日，大人？

lines.en: Donar, why have you given me this test...  give me the strength to be free...
lines.zh: 多纳尔，您为什么要如此试炼我…… 请给我放下过去的勇气吧……
